title: Google I/O: Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni launched
summary: Google made Gemini 3.5 Flash the default model across Gemini and Search, launched Gemini Omni (any-input-to-video multimodal model) and said Gemini 3.5 Pro is due in June. Gemini app passed 900M monthly users.
reason: New frontier-lab model generation with notable gains; mostly Google's own benchmark claims.

title: Google launches Gemini Spark 24/7 agent and agent payments protocol
summary: Google introduced Gemini Spark, a background agent running on cloud VMs that acts across Gmail/Workspace, plus Managed Agents API and an agent payments protocol letting agents buy on users' behalf within limits.
reason: Agents given standing access and spending authority at consumer scale.

title: Google unveils TPU 8t/8i, its first dual-chip TPU generation
summary: Google announced TPU 8t for training (about 3x raw compute of predecessor) and 8i for inference.

title: Google, Samsung confirm Android XR AI glasses for fall 2026
summary: Google said Gemini-powered Android XR glasses from Samsung with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker frames will ship this fall in audio and display versions.
reason: Always-on AI wearables move human-AI integration closer to the body; consumer device announcement.

title: SynthID watermark adopted by OpenAI, Kakao and ElevenLabs
summary: Google said SynthID has watermarked over 100 billion files and detection is coming to Search and Chrome, with OpenAI, Kakao and ElevenLabs adopting it.
reason: Cross-company provenance standard; modest control/trust improvement.

title: KPMG deploys Claude to 276,000 staff in 138 countries
summary: KPMG and Anthropic announced a global alliance and 'Digital Gateway Powered by Claude' covering KPMG's whole workforce.
reason: Enterprise lock-in for one frontier lab; incremental.
